summary: Iteration 41 backend calc engine + PIN/DISCOM/pump UI validated. All 13 pytest unit tests in test_calculators.py pass. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter41_api.py covering 12 API scenarios — 11 pass; 1 real backend bug found: calculation_snapshot is NOT persisted on POST /api/projects (missing in project_doc dict). Frontend UI on the Materials step correctly renders ps-pin-block, PIN 641001 auto-fills district/state/DISCOM + shows 4.65 kWh/kWp/day yield with 'slab-aware calc' badge, ps-bill-savings-strip shows Pre ₹3,500 / Post ₹25 / Save ₹3,502, selecting Solar Pump + expanding advanced reveals ps-pump-block with DC/AC path toggles, TDH inputs, PM-KUSUM section, and ps-pump-live-result panel.

critical.issue: calculation_snapshot field is accepted by ProjectCreate Pydantic model but is NEVER written into project_doc at server.py:2466-2493. Consequently GET /api/projects/{id} returns snapshot={} even when it was posted. This defeats the whole point of persisting the calc snapshot alongside a project. Same fix likely needed in the ProjectUpdate handler (~line 2798).

minor.issue: Returns 400 with 'PIN already exists' instead of the more standard 409 Conflict.

Field is named `tariff_category` inside `inputs`, but the FE/docs sometimes call it `category_name`. Consider accepting both aliases for robustness — currently passing category_name silently falls back to Domestic (root cause of an initial test failure).

issues: ps-pump-block is only rendered inside the collapsed 'Show more options (advanced)' section. That is fine as-is, but the primary pump inputs (TDH, flow, HP) really belong above the fold once system_type=solar-pump is chosen — currently a user must switch to Solar Pump and then also click 'Show more options' before they see any pump-specific fields.

action_items: In server.py create_project (~line 2466) add: 'calculation_snapshot': project.calculation_snapshot or None into project_doc. Also verify update_project handler mirrors this so PUTs persist snapshot changes.
Consider moving the pump-specific block (TDH/flow/HP) out of the collapsed 'advanced' section when system_type=solar-pump, so pump users see the primary inputs immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >5700 lines — this violates the 'files >700 lines split' guideline and makes it very easy for regressions like the missing calculation_snapshot write to slip through.
The calculators/ package cleanly encapsulates the numeric logic and is well tested (13 pytest cases). Good.
PIN CRUD returns 400 for duplicate — should be 409.

Solution endpoint accepts `pincode` at top-level but expects DISCOM-related fields (tariff_category) inside `inputs` — this dual-location schema is confusing. Consider flattening or documenting the schema clearly.
